sendControls.queueReplyUnknown: Checking whether this message was queued. Keep this copy closed to further sends until the queue can be checked.
sendControls.title: Scheduled sends
sendControls.policy: Scheduling is local. Pebble must be running (including in the tray) to send. After restarting, overdue messages and interrupted sends need your review; they are never sent late automatically.
sendControls.undoHint: Undo stops a waiting message before delivery starts. It cannot recall mail already accepted by a server.
sendControls.undoWaiting: Delivery is starting. Cancellation may no longer be possible.
sendControls.dst: At a repeated daylight-saving hour, the earlier occurrence is selected. Check the displayed UTC offset. Nonexistent local times are rejected.
sendControls.invalidTime: Choose a valid future local time within one year.
sendControls.queued: Scheduled locally. Manage it in Settings → General → Scheduled sends.
sendControls.draftCleanupFailed: Scheduled locally, but the original saved draft could not be removed. You can remove that copy from Drafts.
sendControls.restoreWarning: This stops any waiting delivery and opens an editable draft. An interrupted send may already have been accepted: check Sent and the Outbox before sending again. Continue?
sendControls.restored: Delivery stopped. An encrypted backup is kept here until you remove it.
sendControls.removeWarning: Permanently remove this local scheduled-send backup?
sendControls.error: Could not update this message. It may already be sending. Refresh and check Sent before trying again.
sendControls.reviewWarning: Needs review: this message was overdue, interrupted, or its delivery could not be confirmed. It will not retry automatically. Check Sent and Outbox before restoring or sending again.
sendControls.exitMessage: Scheduled messages only send while Pebble is running. Quitting stops the worker; overdue and Undo Send messages will require review next time. An in-flight message may already be accepted and must not be blindly resent.
sendControls.reviewNotice: Some scheduled sends need review in Settings → General.
